correctness.rationale: Exact alternating-sojourn simplex volume and exponential holding density give p_k(u) proportional to u^k(1-u)^(k-1) exp(-delta u); folding gives decreasing LR of A; conditional sign g_delta(a) strictly rises in a for delta<=2; beta-tilt asymptotics m_k=1/2+(2-delta)/(8k)+O(k^-2) force nonmonotonicity for delta>2. Numerical standard-library checker provides independent finite corroboration, not an infinite certificate.

value.rationale: Transition-rate asymmetry creates a sharp dimensionless threshold between decreasing and nonmonotone occupation regression by complete return cycles, despite universal concentration of absolute occupation imbalance.
